meta.title: Master Lease - Real Estate Management Platform

intro.prompt: Real estate portfolio, property management dashboard, modern architecture

scenes.voiceover: Welcome to Master Lease. The complete platform for analyzing co-living deals.
Click Run Deal Analyzer to bring the pricing suite into view.
Enter a zip code to load live room comps and whole-home rents.
Load the zip profile so the system caches your market assumptions.
Add room comps to capture micro-level rent detail.
Add a whole-home comparable to benchmark overall performance.
Scroll through the analyzer to see the live profit stack and metrics.
Jump to listings to browse available properties in your target market.
Submit a new listing to share with operators and investors.
Choose a membership tier to unlock full access to deals and comps.
Every action is governed by Action Authority, keeping compliance locked in.
Master Lease. Price rooms with confidence. Pay owners on time. Keep the spread.
